Description: Missing backend entrypoint file app/main.py. FastAPI app instance is never created and routers are never included.
User Impact: Backend container fails immediately on boot with ModuleNotFoundError or uvicorn target error.
Reproduction: Run docker-compose up or uvicorn app.main:app

Description: deepcopy function is used in POST /chatbot/chat but is not imported in router/chatbot.py.
User Impact: Any user sending a chat message to the chatbot triggers a HTTP 500 server crash due to NameError.

Description: Attribute access current_user.id is used in GET /chatbot/status instead of dict indexing current_user['id'] or current_user['_id'].
User Impact: Status endpoint crashes with 500 Internal Server Error when called by authenticated user.

Description: Chatbot router checks session in db.chat_collection but inserts new session into db.chat_sessions.
User Impact: Existing chat sessions are never found upon re-initialization, causing duplicate session insertions or race conditions.
Reproduction: Initialize chat twice for same user

Description: Rate limiter decorator catches openai.RateLimitError but ChatGroq model raises groq.RateLimitError.
User Impact: LLM rate limit errors trigger unhandled exceptions instead of exponent backoff retries.
Reproduction: Trigger Groq rate limit in chat

Description: Frontend api.js passes headers object into token argument of getDashboardOverview causing 'Authorization: Bearer [object Object]'.
User Impact: Dashboard page fails to fetch data from backend and displays error state.

Description: HomeWorkHelper.jsx references undefined variable suggestionsMessage on image upload.
User Impact: Uploading homework image throws Uncaught ReferenceError in browser console.

Description: loginUser in api.js attempts to access response.access_token on Axios response object instead of response.data or cookie.
User Impact: Token is saved as string 'undefined' in localStorage.

Description: Quiz page uses hardcoded mock questions and ignores backend /quiz/ route.
User Impact: Quiz page does not use AI quiz generation service.

Description: mongo_db.py contains hardcoded Atlas URI username and collection name overriding config.py settings.
User Impact: Security risk exposing DB user; prevents environment configuration.

Description: user_activity collection is queried by dashboard endpoints but no backend endpoint or service ever writes to user_activity.
User Impact: Recent activity and weekly stats always return empty list/0 count.

Affected Files: Rendering Sidebar component would throw ReferenceError (though Sidebar is currently unused).
